255   // Comparisons - operation is encoded in rnd_mode_q:
256   // RNE = LE, RTZ = LT, RDN = EQ
257   // op_mod_q inverts boolean outputs
258   always_comb begin : comparisons
259     // Default assignment
260     cmp_result = '0; // false
261     cmp_status = '0; // no flags
262 
263     // Signalling NaNs always compare as false and are illegal
264     if (signalling_nan) cmp_status.NV = 1'b1; // invalid operation
265     // Otherwise do comparisons
266     else begin
267       unique case (inp_pipe_rnd_mode_q[NUM_INP_REGS])
268         fpnew_pkg::RNE: begin // Less than or equal
269           if (any_operand_nan) cmp_status.NV = 1'b1; // Signalling comparison: NaNs are invalid
270           else cmp_result = (operand_a_smaller | operands_equal) ^ inp_pipe_op_mod_q[NUM_INP_REGS];
271         end
272         fpnew_pkg::RTZ: begin // Less than
273           if (any_operand_nan) cmp_status.NV = 1'b1; // Signalling comparison: NaNs are invalid
274           else cmp_result = (operand_a_smaller & ~operands_equal) ^ inp_pipe_op_mod_q[NUM_INP_REGS];
275         end
276         fpnew_pkg::RDN: begin // Equal
277           if (any_operand_nan) cmp_result = inp_pipe_op_mod_q[NUM_INP_REGS]; // NaN always not equal
278           else cmp_result = operands_equal ^ inp_pipe_op_mod_q[NUM_INP_REGS];
279         end
280         default: cmp_result = '{default: fpnew_pkg::DONT_CARE}; // don't care
281       endcase
282     end
283   end
